subject.title: fix(telegram): Allow multi-agent ACP bindings within same account

question: Should Telegram support multiple independent same-account ACP session bindings in one topic, or should one topic keep a single current binding with explicit handoff semantics?
rationale: Current docs and runtime resolution treat a conversation binding as singular, while the PR requests a multi-binding behavior that needs routing semantics before a mechanical repair is safe.

options.title: Support independent same-topic bindings
options.body: Rework the storage key and routing contract so multiple same-account ACP sessions can coexist and follow-up messages resolve predictably.

options.title: Support same-account handoff only
options.body: Keep one active binding per account/topic and update the PR goal, tests, and proof to describe an explicit ownership switch.

options.title: Keep the current single-binding model
options.body: Close or reject the direction unless a separate maintainer-sponsored design defines multi-session topic routing.

recommendation.title: Support independent same-topic bindings
recommendation.body: Rework the storage key and routing contract so multiple same-account ACP sessions can coexist and follow-up messages resolve predictably.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete introduced the current Telegram plugin-state storage contract and merged the refactor most affected by this PR.
